description:
*“Please don't push your disciple away anymore, Master..”*

Ryu Jang-Jin lives an ordinary life, finding his only escape in web novels during his daily subway commute. But one evening, on his way home, a mysterious man suddenly breaks through his apartment window—from the third floor, no less! The intruder, Sa Wi-Hyeon, claims to be Jang-Jin’s disciple, insisting that their true home isn’t Earth, but a place called Honwon. He has come to take Jang-Jin back where he belongs. As an avid reader of isekai and wuxia novels, Jang-Jin is tempted by the fantastical idea—but reality calls, and he has work in the morning. Ignoring his protests, Sa Wi-Hyeon insists that Jang-Jin is only refusing because he has lost his memories. Before Jang-Jin can argue, he finds himself kidnapped and dragged into another world…

(Source: Lezhin US)
